modules.title: Modules
modules.description: Group tasks into epics, milestones or sprints and follow how their work burns down.
modules.openEmpty: No module is open. Make one with New module, or reopen one from Closed.
modules.closedEmpty: No module is closed yet. A module moves here when its state is Closed.

empty.title: No modules yet
empty.body: Make a module to group tasks and follow how its work burns down.

base.label: Base branch
base.checkedOutNow: {{branch}} now · its tasks take the branch checked out when each run starts
base.checkedOutDetached: Its tasks take the branch checked out when each run starts
base.creates: Choosing it creates the local branch {{branch}}

note.none: Its tasks without a base branch of their own will run from it. Runs under way keep theirs.
note.one: Its 1 task without a base branch of its own runs from it. Runs under way keep theirs.
note.other: Its {{count}} tasks without a base branch of their own run from it. Runs under way keep theirs.

page.notFoundBody: It may have been removed from this project's data.
page.noTasks: No task is in this module yet. Choose it as a task's module on the task form or the task's page.

burndown.title: Burndown
burndown.subtitle: Remaining work at the end of each day
burndown.noTarget: Set a target date to see the ideal line.
burndown.forecast: Likely done by {{likely}} (50%) or {{safe}} (85%), forecast from the tasks merged in this project on its last {{days}} days ({{tasks}} merged).
burndown.notEnoughHistory: Forecast: not enough history yet. The project's last {{days}} days had {{tasks}} tasks merged; a forecast needs 10 days and 3 merged tasks.

team.readOnly: Only Admins create and change modules: {{admins}}. You claim a module to work on all its tasks.
team.readOnlyUnnamed: Only Admins create and change modules. You claim a module to work on all its tasks.

unavailable.title: The modules can't be read now
unavailable.body: {{server}} hasn't answered since {{time}}. The modules show again when it does; Orchester keeps no copy of them.

page.readOnly: Only Admins change this module, its tasks and its branch: {{admins}}. You read it, run its tasks and claim them.
page.readOnlyUnnamed: Only Admins change this module, its tasks and its branch. You read it, run its tasks and claim them.
page.unavailableTitleUnnamed: This module can't be read now
page.unavailableBody: {{server}} hasn't answered since {{time}}. The module's tasks, branch, claim and delivery show again when it does; Orchester keeps no copy of them.
page.runningOne: {{task}}, one of its tasks, is still running on this computer; open it from Running in the sidebar.
page.runningOther: {{tasks}}, some of its tasks, are still running on this computer; open them from Running in the sidebar.
page.noBurndown: A team module's burndown isn't shown yet: the team server doesn't send it to this version of Orchester.

work.heading: Work and delivery
work.nobodyDetail: Picking up a module claims all of its {{tasks}} tasks.
work.hereTitle: Claimed by you on this computer
work.elsewhereTitle: Claimed by you on another computer
work.claimDetail: Picked up {{picked}}; the claim covers all {{tasks}} tasks · last renewed {{time}}. Its tasks' runs don't renew it.
work.staleDetail: No renewal for {{age}} min; the stale threshold is {{minutes}} min. A take over would claim all {{tasks}} tasks for you.
work.branchDetail: Task runs merge into it; only module delivery takes it to main.
work.branchDetailMember: Task runs merge into it; only module delivery takes it to main. Admins change it.
work.branchMerges: Task runs from now on merge into the new branch; module delivery takes it to main.
work.branchLocked: The branch can't change while a run of this module is working.
work.branchUnique: Name a branch no other module uses; the team server refuses one that is taken.
work.branchTaken: Another module already works on this branch, or it is no branch name. Name one no other module uses.
work.conflictDetail: It's {{current}} now; you asked for {{asked}}. Nothing of yours was saved.
work.yoursToAsk: Ask for it when the module's work is done; an Admin authorizes it, or Automatic merge does.
work.holderAsks: {{holder}} asks for it when the module's work is done; an Admin authorizes it, or Automatic merge does.
work.nobodyAsks: The module's holder asks for it when the module's work is done; an Admin authorizes it, or Automatic merge does.
work.theirsDetail: Only the module's holder asks for delivery; Admins authorize it.
work.requestedDetail: You asked to merge {{branch}} at {{source}} into {{base}}; the team server's answer is on its way.
work.awaitingTitle: Delivery requested · waits for an Admin
work.awaitingDetail: You asked at {{time}} to merge {{branch}} at {{source}} into {{base}}. An Admin authorizes it; Automatic merge is off.
work.awaitingOtherDetail: {{holder}} asked at {{time}} to merge {{branch}} at {{source}} into {{base}}. An Admin authorizes it; Automatic merge is off.
work.awaitingAdminTitle: Delivery to main waits for your authorization
work.awaitingAdminDetail: {{holder}} asked at {{time}} to merge {{branch}} at {{source}} into {{base}} at {{baseCommit}}. Automatic merge is off, so an Admin authorizes these exact commits.
work.awaitingAdminYourDetail: You asked at {{time}} to merge {{branch}} at {{source}} into {{base}} at {{baseCommit}}. Automatic merge is off, so an Admin authorizes these exact commits.
work.authorizedDetail: For {{branch}} at {{source}} onto {{base}} at {{baseCommit}}; new commits need a new authorization.
work.automaticDetail: Automatic merge is on, so it stands for an Admin's authorization of this module claim's delivery.
work.mergeFailedDetail: Merging {{branch}} at {{source}} into {{base}} failed on this computer; nothing was merged.
work.withdrawnDetail: An Admin turned Automatic merge off before this delivery was reported. Ask again; an Admin authorizes it.

refused.branchTitle: Can't change the branch while work runs
refused.deliverTitle: Couldn't ask for the delivery of {{module}}
refused.branchRunning: A run of {{module}} is working on {{branch}}. Change the branch when no run of {{module}} is working.
refused.takeOverRunning: A task of {{module}} is Running under {{holder}}'s module claim. The team server refuses a module take over while one of its runs is Running; try again when it has stopped.
refused.conflict: Someone else holds the module's claim now.
refused.lost: The module's claim isn't this computer's any more.
refused.busy: An agent of one of its runs is at work; pause or stop it first.
refused.denied: The team server doesn't allow it while the module stands as it does now.
refused.decision: The team server waits for a decision before it allows this.
refused.notAuthorized: The authorization it names isn't an Admin's authorization of these exact commits.
refused.changed: The module changed on the team server meanwhile; nothing was changed.
refused.unavailable: The team server can't be reached now; nothing was changed. Try again.
refused.needsVersion: The team server needs Orchester {{version}}; nothing was changed. Update Orchester, then try again.
refused.signedOut: This computer isn't signed in to the team server.
refused.failed: It could not be carried out on this computer.
refused.workRunning: Runs of the module still work on this computer; ask once they've stopped.
refused.noBase: The checkout has no branch checked out to deliver onto, other than the module's own.
refused.branchMissing: The module's branch {{branch}} isn't in this checkout.
